title: System-Viz Coverage Discrepancy Fix (BUILD_STATE 72% vs viz 88%)

ship_record.summary: L5 engine-domain coverage now single-sourced from BUILD_STATE.COVERAGE_BY_DOMAIN.rows via new pure lib scripts/lib/viz-domain-coverage.mjs. meta.coverage added. 41 L5 nodes (top-40 + eng.miscdomains rest), 0 dup ids, sum === BUILD_STATE row sum exactly. 18-case node:test suite. 3-of-3 per-file scrutiny PASS.
ship_record.deferred_p2: dispatcherToDomains L4->L5 edge heuristic still emits legacy semantic tokens (cad/cam/wedm/safety/cost/erp/inspect/memory/quality) with no matching node in the new prefix taxonomy; the loop now WARNS them loudly (R12) instead of silent-dropping. Re-mapping the heuristic to the BUILD_STATE prefix taxonomy is a separate design unit.

rationale: BUILD_STATE.json reports 2269 wired/3167 total (72%) but system-viz coverage-by-domain reports 2802 wired/3176 total (88%). Same metric, two answers (delta=533 in numerator). Root cause traced 2026-05-10: generate-system-viz.mjs lines 257-282 has a hardcoded domainsBuiltIn block summing to 2802, instead of reading buildState.COVERAGE_BY_DOMAIN.rows from build-state-snapshot.mjs (lines 191-228, single source of truth). Fix is one-source-replacement in viz, NOT extension to snapshot. CLAUDE.md regression entry already documents this discrepancy. Independent of HOOK-SYNERGY and K2-CLOUD.

reference: scripts/build-state-snapshot.mjs (591 lines, lines 191-228 = computeCoverageByDomain — single source of truth)

units.title: Replace hardcoded domainsBuiltIn block in scripts/generate-system-viz.mjs lines 257-282 with read of buildState.COVERAGE_BY_DOMAIN.rows from BUILD_STATE.json. Verify regenerated viz matches BUILD_STATE numbers (2269 wired / 3167 total / 72%). Update CLAUDE.md regression entry to RESOLVED.
deliverables: scripts/generate-system-viz.mjs (L5 section single-sourced; meta.coverage added; legacy eng.other catchall removed)

acceptance_criteria: scripts/generate-system-viz.mjs reads from buildState.COVERAGE_BY_DOMAIN.rows (no hardcoded block)
Regenerated viz reports same wired/total/% as BUILD_STATE.json
CLAUDE.md regression entry updated to RESOLVED with commit SHA
Test: generate-system-viz output asserts COVERAGE_BY_DOMAIN values match buildState
compounding_artifact: Adds an integration test enforcing single-source-of-truth between build-state-snapshot and generate-system-viz
boris_loop_gate: Single-unit milestone — peer reviewer subagent verifies the fix actually closes the discrepancy (not just papers over it)
